text:
jess: Heads-up — GreenLoop just reported their promo grant landed in the staging/hosted project instead of their Dedicated prod tenant. Provisioning for Dedicated tenant `dedicated-greenloop-prod` is blocked.

jess: Promo code `GRANT-APR24-GREEN` applied to `greenloop-staging-dev` (hosted) for $5,000 credits. Customer expects it on `tenant-ded-01` (Dedicated). Screenshot: https://redwood.internal/screencaps/greenloop/grant-landing.png

sam: Ugh. Do we know whether the grant is tied to org id or project id? Can you paste the org/hosted project ids?

jess: org: `org-greenloop` project: `proj-green-stg-01` tenant id (dedicated): `tenant-ded-01`. Promo metadata: {code: GRANT-APR24-GREEN, amount: 5000, applied_to: proj-green-stg-01, applied_at: 1764829000 UTC}

maria: If the credit landed on a hosted project we can either revoke and reissue or migrate the grant on the backend. Revoke+reissue requires legal signoff if the promo was already consumed. Did they spend any tokens yet?

jess: Customer says they haven't used any of the credits. Billing dashboard shows 0 usage.

ben: We have an internal tool to reassign promo grants: `promo-migrate --from-project proj-green-stg-01 --to-tenant tenant-ded-01 --code GRANT-APR24-GREEN` — it updates billing_namespace and entitlements. Need an owner with billing perms to run. It logs an audit event. No downtime expected but Dedicated provisioning will recheck quotas after migration.

ben: Caveat: if Dedicated capacity was reserved under a different billing namespace the provision step might be blocked by quota mismatch. If provision fails you'll see `provision_error: reserved_capacity_not_found` in the tenant events.

jess: The customer's Dedicated provisioning shows the following error in the tenant events: `provision_error: reserved_capacity_not_found (billing_namespace mismatch)` — they opened a support ticket and are getting nervous. Can someone run the migrate?

ops-bot: Created incident INC-2024-0421-87 and linked this thread. Assigned to @ben and @maria.

maria: I can run the revoke+reissue if needed. But since there's no usage, migration is less noisy. Ben — can you run `promo-migrate` and paste the audit id here? Also we need a confirmation message to the customer before touching their accounts.

ben: I'll run the migration in staging then prod. Steps I will take: 1) Run dry-run `promo-migrate --from proj-green-stg-01 --to tenant-ded-01 --code GRANT-APR24-GREEN --dry-run` 2) Verify audit log 3) Run actual migration 4) Re-trigger Dedicated provisioning check. Expected output snippet on success: 
```
PROMO-MIGRATE: dry-run OK
audit_id: audit-78f3c
changes: billing_namespace: proj-green-stg-01 -> tenant-ded-01
```

ben: ETA ~ 30m. Maria — can you prepare the legal/finance approval in parallel (just a one-line approval in this thread will do since it's internal and credits unused)?

liz: I'll notify the GreenLoop account team and ask for a 1-hour maintenance window. I'll tell them we plan to migrate credits and re-run provisioning checks.

sam: Also add the repro note for eng-runtime: when tenant provisioning fails due to quota mismatch, the API returns 409 with body `{"error":"reserved_capacity_not_found","namespace":"<old>"}`. Please include that in the internal postmortem so we can give clearer messaging during provisioning.

ben: Dry-run complete: `audit_id: audit-78f3c-dry` — results look clean. Running prod now.

ben: Migration finished. `audit_id: audit-78f3c` — promo now bound to `tenant-ded-01`. Billing namespace updated. Re-triggering provisioning check...

ben: Provisioning re-check succeeded. Tenant status -> `ACTIVE`. Customer token tests OK.

maria: Finance signoff: approved to migrate since no usage recorded. Logged approval: `maria@redwood — approved migration GRANT-APR24-GREEN -> tenant-ded-01`

liz: GreenLoop notified and confirmed they're unblocked. Thanks team. :tada:

jess: Closing the incident. INC-2024-0421-87 -> resolved. Please add the migration tool steps to docs in `runbooks/promo-migration.md`.

sam: Filed a small eng task to improve error text on quota mismatch: TASK-ENG-4523.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2024-0421-87 marked resolved by ben at 1764829165.
